other_conditions: Prospective adoptive parents must have at least two years of a stable marital relationship.
Unmarried/single male individuals are not eligible to adopt a girl child.
Prospective adoptive parents should have adequate financial resources to raise the child.
Single prospective adoptive parents should be between 30 and 55 years of age.
For a child up to 4 years, the combined age of the adoptive parents must not exceed 90 years.
For a single prospective adoptive parent adopting a child up to 4 years, age must be between 25 and 45 years.
For a child between 4 and 8 years, the combined age of the adoptive parents must not exceed 100 years.
For a single prospective adoptive parent adopting a child between 4 and 8 years, age must be between 25 and 50 years.
For a child between 8 and 18 years, the combined age of the adoptive parents must not exceed 110 years.
For a single prospective adoptive parent adopting a child between 8 and 18 years, age must be between 25 and 55 years.
benefits_summary: Provides accommodation, food, and healthcare for the child and grants a special adoption leave of 270 days to female government employees who adopt a child below one year.
